definitions: A professional who applies engineering principles to biological systems and molecules, often focusing on the design, analysis, and manipulation of biomolecules and biological processes.
An engineer specializing in the development of technologies and products that interact with biological systems at a molecular level.
examples: The biomolecular engineer developed a new drug delivery system.
She consulted with a biomolecular engineer on the project.
Many biomolecular engineers work in the pharmaceutical industry.
